create.name: Lynne Twist
create.bio:
Lynne Twist has spent more than forty years working to end hunger and poverty, to support women and girls and to protect the Amazon rainforest, and out of that work came her way of seeing money as a mirror of what we value most. She co-founded the Pachamama Alliance, which partners with Indigenous peoples of the Ecuadorian Amazon, and she founded the Soul of Money Institute, where she teaches with her colleague Sara Vetter. Her path has taken her to Mother Teresa's work in Kolkata and to refugee camps in Ethiopia, and she has advised philanthropic families and the Nobel Women's Initiative on fundraising.

Her best-known book, The Soul of Money (2003), looks at how the belief that there is never enough shapes the way we earn, spend and give, and invites a quieter sense of sufficiency; it has appeared in many languages. Living a Committed Life (2022) explores what becomes possible when people give themselves to a purpose larger than their own lives. Through the institute she offers recorded online courses, coaching, consulting and talks, and her ten-day Commune course gathers lessons and practices on gratitude, enough-ness and generosity in our dealings with money.

books.title: The Soul of Money: Transforming Your Relationship with Money and Life
books.author: Lynne Twist
books.description: Drawing on her years of fundraising for the Hunger Project and her time with communities around the world, she examines the myths of scarcity that drive how we treat money. The book offers a practical, values-based alternative built on sufficiency, appreciation and conscious giving.

books.title: Living a Committed Life: Finding Freedom and Fulfillment in a Purpose Larger Than Yourself
books.author: Lynne Twist
books.description: Through stories from her decades of activism, she shows how dedicating yourself to something bigger than personal goals can bring energy, meaning and a surprising sense of freedom. Each chapter closes with reflections for finding your own commitment.

courses.title: The Soul of Money
courses.description: A ten-day course of video lessons, meditations and practices drawn from her book, about four hours in all. It looks at the habits of scarcity we inherit and offers ways to relate to money with gratitude, purpose and generosity; a short bonus session on fundraising is included.

courses.title: Peace & Freedom with Money & Life
courses.description: The on-demand companion course to The Soul of Money, taught with Sara Vetter in five hour-long recorded lessons. It works on letting go of old money patterns and building a steady sense of sufficiency and what she calls spiritual net worth.

courses.title: Awakening Women to Transform the World
courses.description: A six-part recorded course for women, co-taught with Sara Vetter, on finding purpose, voice and leadership. It draws on feminine wisdom and the changes the world is going through, and can be repeated as often as you like.

courses.title: Fundraising From the Heart Workshop
courses.description: A recorded three-part workshop with Sara Vetter, around four and a half hours long, for people raising money for causes they care about. It applies the Soul of Money ideas of sufficiency to fundraising and practises the conversation of asking.

free_resources.title: 3 Steps to Money Forgiveness
free_resources.description: A free short masterclass, roughly ten minutes, on making peace with past money mistakes. She walks through letting go of old regrets and opening to a healthier flow of resources; access is by email sign-up.

free_resources.title: The Keys to Living a Committed Life
free_resources.description: A free eight-minute video teaching linked to her book Living a Committed Life. It covers listening for a calling and meeting challenges as part of a purposeful life; access is by email sign-up.

Her teaching is about money, sufficiency and purpose rather than a contemplative practice; spiritual framing (soul, sufficiency, gratitude, commitment) is explicit, but a human may want to confirm fit. Subjects chosen: soul-purpose, spirituality, consciousness.
Sara Vetter co-teaches the institute's courses and is not on Spiritpedia.
